name: Low Vision Simulator
summary:
The Low Vision Simulator illustrates different symptoms that individuals diagnosed with an Inherited Retinal Dystrophy (IRD) may experience, allowing users to adjust their intensity level.
This project is an initiative of the Asociación Andaluza de Retinosis Pigmentaria (AARP), funded by the Diputación de Sevilla and developed in technological collaboration with Singular Learning.
